title: Oy oxiridagi buyurtma qaysi oyga yoziladi
caption: ❓ Savol: «Buyurtmani oktabr oxirida berdim. Qaysi oy normasiga yoziladi?» Buyurtma sanasi ham, posilka kelgan kun ham emas — bojxonada rasmiylashtirilgan sana hisoblanadi. 📅 Misol (kuryer, norma — oyiga 200 $) • 10-oktabr: 1-posilka rasmiylashtirildi — 150 $ (tovar + yo'l) • 28-oktabr: 2-buyurtma berildi — 120 $ • 3-noyabr: 2-posilka rasmiylashtirildi → noyabr normasiga yoziladi Natija: oktabrda 150 $, noyabrda 120 $ — ikkalasi ham norma ichida, boj yo'q ✅ Agar 2-posilka 30-oktabrda rasmiylashtirilganda edi — oktabr jami 270 $, 70 $ normadan oshardi ❌ 💡 Maslahat • Oy oxirida xarid qilsangiz — trek-raqam orqali posilka qachon rasmiylashtirilishini kuzating • Katta xaridni oy boshiga rejalang — oyning normasi to'liq turadi 📄 Asos: VM 244-son, 19.04.2025 — lex.uz 📲 Oylik normangizni ilovada kuzating ➖➖➖ @Pochtam_shopo #savol
prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#savol".
2) Center: two wall-calendar pages, October and November, side by side; a cardboard parcel with a small indigo stamp sits on the November page, and a curved arrow shows it moving from late October to early November. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of sky blue (#38BDF8); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Qaysi oy normasiga yoziladi?"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Rasmiylashtirilgan sana hisoblanadi"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: Norma kalendar oy bo'yicha, rasmiylashtirilgan sana bo'yicha — muallif tasdiqlagan (BRIEF.md). Yetkazish narxi bojxona qiymatiga kiradi — misoldagi summalarni «tovar + yo'l» deb tushuning.
